summary_en: Metaplanet announced a share buyback authorization alongside the issuance of zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2031 denominated in euros. The acquisition framework details, specific share quantities, price limits, and execution methods will be confirmed upon finalization of issuance conditions.
title_en: Supplementary Explanation Material regarding Euro Yen Convertible Bond Issuance and Share Acquisition
translation_en_brief:
Metaplanet Inc. disclosed supplementary materials regarding the issuance of zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2031 in euro yen and the establishment of a share buyback authorization framework. The disclosure indicates that the company will acquire its own shares through two methods: off-market block trading (ToSTNeT-3) and market purchases. However, the specific acquisition parameters—including the total number of shares to be acquired, the maximum acquisition amount, price ceilings, and the acquisition period—remain conditional and will be finalized when the convertible bond issuance conditions are determined.

The company emphasized that the actual quantities and aggregate acquisition prices under the ToSTNeT-3 program may fall short of projections depending on the volume of sell orders, and that additional market purchases may vary in volume, price, and timing based on share price movements and mNAV levels. The disclosure notes that the convertible bonds will not be offered or sold within Japan or in the United States, and that conversion terms do not guarantee the maintenance of mNAV levels at the time of conversion.
